condiments.name: Taffy Strip
condiments.description: A rolling twelve-cell shortcut strip for Windows apps, files, folders, and web links.

agent.instructions: Taffy Strip is an optional Condiment. Discover condiment-shortcuts in the shared registry and the installed ID using condiment-status. Open the strip before using preview-cell or organize. Cell indices are 0–11. Use the returned window ID to target the organizer draft: pick or drop one target at a time, link HTTP(S) URLs, rename, remove, and move to reorder. Save with save-editor or discard with cancel-editor. Launch only the requested shortcut by saved ID. Thumbnail generates an image if supported and clear-thumbnails clears only cached previews. These controls require local authority. Removing a shortcut clears its generated thumbnails and leaves its target on disk. In an organizer, removal and cache cleanup apply on save.
